question: Which of the following countries had awarded Prime Minister Narendra Modi its highest civilian honour in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyprus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was conferred with the **Grand Collar of the Order of Makarios III**, which is the highest civilian honour of **Cyprus**, in **June 2025**.
 
• The award was presented during a high-level diplomatic visit to recognize his outstanding contribution to strengthening the **bilateral relations** between **India** and **Cyprus** and for his global leadership.
 
• The **Order of Makarios III** is named after **Archbishop Makarios III**, who was the first **President of Cyprus** and a founding member of the **Non-Aligned Movement (NAM)**, a platform where **India** has historically played a leading role.
